faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for AUS?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 agriculture table describes government fee-reimbursement assistance for eligible APST students, subject to scheme terms and approval. The university also limits concurrent scholarship applications to one award. Its separate scholarship form deadline of 30 October 2026 is already past. This is a maximum conditional benefit, not an automatic deduction or a guaranteed award; the brochure does not give renewal rules. Government stipend / scholarship application route: The university directs eligible students to Arunachal Pradesh or Government of India granting agencies and limits concurrent applications to one award. The listed university submission deadline was30October2026; no current agriculture-specific entitlement is established.
